title: Name a number
summary: COBOL: Name a number. Change the starting value to 6.
introduction: Working-storage holds data. PIC 9 describes one decimal digit.

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.
